descriptionChirho: Substantive indefinite pronoun referring to an unspecified person: 'someone, anyone, a certain one' — Arabic أَحَدٌ, Korean 누구/어떤 사람, Swahili mtu yeyote.
Substantive indefinite pronoun referring to an unspecified thing: 'something, anything' — Arabic شَيْئًا, Korean 무엇/어떤 것, Swahili kitu/chochote.
Adjectival or determiner use modifying a singular noun to indicate an unspecified but particular referent: 'a certain, some, any' — Arabic وَاحِدٌ/مَا/أَيُّ, Korean 어떤, Swahili fulani/mmoja.
Plural indefinite pronoun or adjective referring to an unspecified subgroup: 'some, certain ones, some of them' — Arabic بَعْضُ, Korean 어떤 이들, Swahili baadhi/wengine.
Interrogative use (overlap with τίς): 'who?' — Arabic مَن, Korean 누가, Swahili nani.
